message: Severe breathing difficulty can be urgent. Seek emergency medical care immediately if breathing is severely impaired.
Severe chest pain may require prompt medical attention. If pain is severe, sudden, or accompanied by shortness of breath, seek emergency care.
Loss of consciousness can be serious. Seek urgent medical evaluation.
Sudden severe confusion may require urgent medical assessment.
Signs of a severe allergic reaction can be life-threatening. Seek emergency care immediately.
